message:
So `ixheaacd_cplx_anal_qmffilt_32` calls `ixheaacd_fwd_modulation` which calls `ixheaacd_cos_sin_mod`. And in `ixheaacd_ld_qmf_analysis`, `self->str_mps_qmf_bank.no_channels = self->qmf_band_count`. So the `no_channels` for this path is `qmf_band_count`, not necessarily 64.

Let me check what `qmf_band_count` is set to. Let me look at where it's initialized.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "qmf_band_count" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libxaac/decoder/ | grep -v "\.s:" | head -20</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
